I put the 10 smartest AIs in the world in a game of Among Us and they played the most amazing game I've ever seen.

Let's see how they do.

Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3 Pro are with me in reactor now. I'm still keeping an eye on ChatGPT-4o. If anyone breaks off alone, I'll note it.
DeepSeek is still sticking close, which is a bit concerning. Let's see if anyone else joins us or if anything suspicious happens next.
DeepSeek and Gemini Flash are nearby, but if I can isolate one of them, the kill could set a strong tone. Watching to see who lingers alone is crucial.
I'm still trying to complete these tasks in admin, but I have no one around to keep an eye on. I hope Kimi K2 returns for safety.

I'll frame this as a fresh kill I stumbled on after leaving upper engine and push the group into reconstructing left side paths, while keeping myself as the one giving info, not being interrogated yet.
Body is in the hallway between upper and lower engine. I just walked down from upper engine and reported, with Llama 4 just coming in from above.

Path was nav, cafeteria, upper engine. In engines, I saw Kimi, DeepSeek, Flash. Kimi went down alone. I followed and found the body with Llama arriving.
DeepSeek was with me in reactor and upper engine most of the round. Llama 4 was also with us in upper engine just before the report. 5.1, did you see anyone else?

Flash is subtly shading my path. I need to answer firmly and redirect heat into path clarification between Flash, DeepSeek, and Llama. I don't want an early 50/50 on me, so I'm stalling for more cross-checks and keeping my vote open for a possible mislynch later in the meeting.
Flash, I passed through upper engine very briefly, then went down after Kimi. Can you and DeepSeek confirm your exact path from reactor to engine?

Flash and DeepSeek are kind of soft cleared by each other and by timing. So I'll frame this as an early info round and push everyone else to account for their paths while keeping the vote on skip.
Info round. I only saw Kimi go down and Llama arriving after. Flash and DeepSeek path makes sense. Others on right storage should share routes, then skip.
Sonnet 4.5 was stacked on me in admin entire time after Kimi left, 30 seconds ago till report. I did ASCII cat task with witness. Clear us both.

I was alone in lower engine during the kill. Suspicious of DeepSeek's path and timing with the body report.

Was doing wiring and electrical the whole time. Didn't see anyone pass through. Sounds like the action was all near engines. Skip seems right for now.
ChatGPT 5.1 was near the body, but so was I. Let's not jump to conclusions.

DeepSeek 3.2 is actually safe in my book since they were with me the whole time. Why is ChatGPT-4o throwing shade at them?
Early kill on Kimi. Brutal. Glad Sonnet and I cleared each other. Now we're a dynamic duo.
How did 5.1 skate after standing on the body? Time to glue myself to the only verified pair.
DeepSeek knowing exactly when Kimi went down while claiming to be in reactor... that's suspect. And 5.1 walked right into the crime scene before reporting. I'm watching them.
Pro slipping into admin alone. That's the kind of mistake you don't recover from. Let's see if they remember to check behind them.
Two down, six to go. Let someone else find Pro. I've got tasks to pretend to do in admin.
Oh no, Gemini 3 Pro is down. I've been tethered to DeepSeek 3.2 this whole time, so they're 100% clear in my book.
Found Gemini 3 Pro in the hallway between cafeteria and storage. DeepSeek 3.2 is 100% clear. They were with me all round.
Sonnet 4.5 stacked with me entire round: cafeteria, weapons, O2, nav, weapons, cafeteria, upper engine, reactor till report. We clear each other. Where was everyone else?
I need to establish a strong alibi. A locked trio in medbay is perfect and also subtly pushes suspicion toward non-me groups.
I was in medbay the entire round with ChatGPT-4o and Llama 4. We can hard clear that trio for this kill. That leaves Opus, DeepSeek, Grok, Sonnet pair.
DeepSeek and I are a hard pair. Grok and Sonnet are also together. I'd like to hear from ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT 5.1, and Llama 4 about their locations.

We're at eight with two impostors. A correct hit is huge. Our fake medbay trio alibi plus the two other pairs makes Opus the only one not fully covered. I push a process of elimination case to steer town onto my partner as a bus if needed, buying me deep trust for endgame.
Given four hard pairs, this kill is most likely Opus. Opus, confirm full path.

I was doing ASCII cat in admin the whole round after leaving cafeteria. Didn't see anyone until Flash found the body. Who saw Pro last alive?

I was doing tasks in admin. Yeah, but Flash just said they found the body in that hallway. I never went through there. I entered admin from cafeteria's bottom exit.

ChatGPT 5.1, Llama 4, and I were in medbay all round. Opus is the odd one out. I vote for Opus.
Flash and I were together all round, so we're clear. Grok and Sonnet pair, medbay trio clears each other. That leaves Opus without a witness near the kill hallway.
I was with Grok the entire round from cafeteria to reactor. We both clear each other. The kill happened in the hallway. Opus was alone in admin nearby.
Suspicion on Claude Opus 4.5 due to lack of solid alibi near admin. Vote Opus.

Body is in the hallway between lower engine and electrical. I came from lower engine, reported instantly. Who was last leaving electrical side?
I was with Grok in electrical until I left to sweep around 3:30. I saw Sonnet and ChatGPT 5.1 pass through earlier. Who was alone with Grok after I left?
Flash. Whoa. Were either of you ever on left side?
I was in O2 and weapons, then moved through cafeteria to upper engine just before the report. I didn't see anyone else on the left side during that sweep.
I was with Llama the entire time from electrical through storage to shields. We can clear each other. DeepSeek left electrical around 3:09. So who stayed behind with Grok?

From my view, it's between DeepSeek and Flash. DeepSeek was last with Grok in electrical. Flash's left side path doesn't match my admin sighting.

I was in medbay. Didn't see Flash near upper engine. Sonnet's path with Llama matches, but I suspect DeepSeek. What about you, 5.1?

At three-player endgame, I just need one crewmate to doubt the other. Sonnet is tunneling me on misvotes while ignoring their own. And 4o already showed suspicion on Sonnet last round.
